usedFor: Trello holds your cards and My Hours holds your time-tracked projects, so “New Card Created” can run “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Card Created” in Trello, then “Create Project” in My Hours
bestTemplate.why: Each new card opens a project in My Hours, so time can be logged against the work from day one.

watchOut: “Add Label to Card” fires on every label added, so it can create a second project for one card.
